messages.content: "請問您能否根據五因素模型和邁爾斯-布里格斯性格分類法（MBTI）分析我的個性？就五因素模型而言，請考慮我很健談，不容易緊張，有許多藝術興趣，不懶惰，並且很寬容。就MBTI而言，我的偏好更傾向於感覺而非思考，比起內向我覺得自己更外向，我更傾向於知覺而非判斷，最後我偏好直覺而非感覺。"

introverted_vs_extroverted.description: Preference of user between introverted and extroverted.

judging_vs_perceiving.description: Preference of user between judging and perceiving.

sensing_vs_intuition.description: Preference of user between sensing and intuition.

function.name: five_factor_model_analyse

nervous.description: Indicates if the user gets nervous easily.

artistic_interests.description: Indicates if the user has many artistic interests.

lazy.description: Indicates if the user tends to be lazy.

forgiving.description: Indicates if the user is forgiving.
